brief:
Kites were flown across 11 Dutch cities on Saturday in a coordinated show of solidarity with children in Gaza, according to Middle East Eye. The Plant an Olive Tree Foundation organized the events to draw public attention to the situation facing young people in the territory.

The foundation chose kites as a symbolic representation of childhood and freedom, mobilizing activists across multiple municipalities in the Netherlands. Participants gathered simultaneously in the 11 cities to demonstrate unified support for Gaza's population through the airborne display.
